python.setup:
trigger = fluentqt.Button("Show ContentDialog", %PARENT%)
trigger.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
trigger.setFixedSize(168, 32)
trigger.move(136, 119)
trigger.show()
control = fluentqt.ContentDialog(%PARENT%)
control.setAnimationEnabled(False)
control.setTitle("Save changes?")
body = fluentqt.Label("Save your edits to \"Release Notes.md\" before closing this document?", control)
body.setWordWrap(True)
body.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
control.setContent(body)
control.setPrimaryButtonText("Save")
control.setSecondaryButtonText("Don't save")
control.setCloseButtonText("Cancel")
control.setDefaultButton(fluentqt.ContentDialog.ContentDialogButton.Primary)
trigger.clicked.connect(control.open)
control.open()
